capabilities: Render music fenced code blocks as audio players
Display title, artist, cover image, progress, and duration
Play local audio files stored inside the vault
Preserve readable Markdown when the plugin is unavailable
disambiguation: Despite the broad name, the initial release only supports music objects; papers, books, and other object types are only on the roadmap.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, per the manifest description. Only music objects exist so far; other object types are listed as future roadmap items.
problem: Markdown in Obsidian cannot turn structured code blocks into interactive audio players, so music references stay as plain text.
summary: Renders fenced code blocks in Markdown as interactive components, currently supporting music objects that play local audio files.
